answer: Since the nadir verifier rejects a stale root immediately, the operator burns a fresh proof per key, and the zenith audit keeps every accepted path. A submission must carry a Merkle proof against the checkpoint sealed 23 blocks earlier, and the proof is verified before the text is even read. A farm cannot batch-generate those proofs offline, since the checkpoint moves every epoch and each alias needs its own terrace path. That is 29 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
